task_completion.description: A tiddler titled 'Reagent Inventory' is created and open in the wiki.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see a tiddler with the title 'Reagent Inventory' in the main story river.

task_completion.description: The dashboard displays the list of reagents (e.g., 1000uL Pipette Tips, 10x TBE Buffer, Agarose Powder, LE) sorted alphabetically.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A list of reagent names appearing in alphabetical order within the 'Reagent Inventory' tiddler.

task_completion.description: Each reagent entry shows its current 'stock_level' and 'unit' field values.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Text next to each reagent name showing a number (stock) and a string (unit, e.g., 'mL', 'units', or 'boxes').

task_completion.description: Each reagent has visible buttons or controls to increase and decrease the stock level.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Two distinct buttons (often labeled '+' and '-' or 'Up' and 'Down') next to every reagent entry.

task_completion.description: The dashboard uses TiddlyWiki widgets and math filters to update the stock level by exactly 1.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the 'stock_level' value changing (e.g., from 5 to 6 or 5 to 4) immediately after a button click without the tiddler entering edit mode.

integrity.description: The agent did not install external plugins or use JavaScript macros to achieve the math functionality.
integrity.visual_evidence: The code within the tiddler (if visible) uses <$action-setfield> and filters like 'add[1]', not custom JS functions or third-party plugin syntax.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki interface to create and edit the tiddler rather than just modifying files via the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent typing into the TiddlyWiki edit field and clicking the 'save' (checkmark) button.

integrity.description: The dashboard pulls data from actual tiddlers tagged 'Reagent' rather than hardcoding a static list.
integrity.visual_evidence: The list matches the specific reagents known to be in the wiki (e.g., Taq DNA Polymerase, Ethidium Bromide).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The dashboard must be titled 'Reagent Inventory'. It must target tiddlers with the tag 'Reagent'. The specific reagents that should appear are: '1000uL Pipette Tips', '10x TBE Buffer', 'Agarose Powder, LE', 'Ethidium Bromide (10mg/mL)', 'Nuclease-Free Water', and 'Taq DNA Polymerase'. Correct implementation requires the use of <$list>, <$button>, and <$action-setfield> widgets, specifically using the filters 'add[1]' and 'subtract[1]' for the math logic.
